domains.name: dungeon_topology
notes: Maps, tiles, offsets, local/global coordinates and placed dungeon objects are source-backed.

domains.name: resource_names
notes: Item names, attack names, door families and many wall ornament names are extracted via sck.

domains.name: render_layout
notes: Post-Atari layout/composition data from 0696 is now structurally exported and partially semantically decoded.

domains.name: door_and_panel_composites
notes: Late 0696 ranges now expose front-door, teleporter/floor, wall/pit and stairs composite panels.

domains.name: helper_templates
notes: NULL helper ids used by 0696 are catalogued with role guesses and stable families.

domains.name: floor_item_distribution
notes: The 3812..3940 range is effectively decoded as a floor-item distribution grid.

domains.name: gameplay_item_tables
notes: Item identity, category mapping and carry-location rules are now externally documented from graphics.dat item 559.
Weapon stats, armor values, potion effects and several misc behaviors are still project-maintained or await companion stat tables.

domains.name: gameplay_creature_tables
notes: Creature descriptors from graphics.dat item 559 are now documented externally, including PC 3.4 variant values.
Runtime creature data is still maintained locally until those descriptors are integrated structurally.

domains.name: actions_and_combos
notes: Action metadata, combo composition, minimum skill gating and charge use are now documented externally.
This fills the link between item attack-combo indexes and actual champion actions.

domains.name: attacks_and_defenses
notes: Attack type semantics and champion defense factors are now documented externally.
This supports a more faithful combat-defense model once integrated.

domains.name: skills_and_experience
notes: Basic/hidden skills, XP rules, level multipliers, training and growth rules are now documented externally.
Resurrect and reincarnate behavior is now documented strongly enough to guide runtime alignment.

domains.name: item559_structure
notes: The original Atari-style logical breakdown of item 559 is now documented in-project and mirrored in a structured JSON reference.
This covers doors, droppings, creature descriptors, weapon descriptors and item descriptors.

domains.name: item560_actions_spells
notes: The original Atari-style logical breakdown of item 560 is now documented in-project and mirrored in a structured JSON reference.
This covers action arrays, combos and spell tables.

domains.name: item562_ui_system
notes: The original Atari-style logical breakdown of item 562 is now documented in-project and mirrored in a structured JSON reference.
This includes carry-location masks, luminance tables, torch mappings and injury/attack-position support tables.

domains.name: pc_binary_gameplay_tables
notes: No contiguous Atari-style I559 gameplay block has been recovered from the PC assets.
The remaining gap appears to be PC-specific binary organization rather than missing file extraction.

domains.name: runtime_door_rendering
notes: The runtime still uses one generic door texture, but original door families and front-view panel composites are now extracted.

domains.name: runtime_wall_decor_mapping
notes: Wall décor fallback logic still uses placeholders such as autel/torch art, even though major original ornament families are now known.
